9618a980497a8c5e.description: تمثيل العلامة التجارية داخل نقاط البيع، شرح مزايا المنتجات للعملاء، تحقيق أهداف البيع الشهرية، إعداد تقارير المبيعات اليومية، والحرص على المظهر اللائق وتطبيق سياسات الشركة. تمثيل الشركة والعلامة التجارية بصورة احترافية داخل نقاط البيع والمعارض والفعاليات التسويقية. استقبال العملاء والتفاعل معهم وشرح مزايا وفوائد المنتجات الطبية المعروضة. تقديم المعلومات الصحيحة عن المنتجات بما يتوافق مع السياسات والتعليمات المعتمدة. تشجيع العملاء على الشراء وتعزيز فرص البيع من خلال إبراز القيمة المضافة للمنتجات. تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الشهرية المحددة من قبل الإدارة. متابعة توفر المنتجات والإبلاغ عن أي نقص أو احتياجات تتعلق بالمخزون. إعداد ورفع تقارير المبيعات اليومية وتقارير الزيارات للجهة المختصة. بناء علاقات إيجابية مع العملاء والمحافظة على مستوى عالٍ من خدمة العملاء. المحافظة على ترتيب وتجهيز منطقة العرض والتأكد من سلامة المواد الترويجية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الشركة والتعليمات المنظمة للعمل داخل نقاط البيع. المحافظة على المظهر المهني اللائق والسلوك الاحترافي الذي يعكس صورة الشركة. شهادة الثانوية العامة كحد أدنى، ويفضل دبلوم أو بكالوريوس في التسويق أو التخصصات الصحية ذات العلاقة. خبرة سابقة في الترويج أو المبيعات، ويفضل في مجال المنتجات التجميلية الطبية مهارات تواصل وإقناع وتقديم عروض متميزة. القدرة على تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية والعمل تحت الضغط. راتب أساسي مجزٍ. عمولات وحوافز مرتبطة بالأداء. تأمين طبي. إجازات سنوية مدفوعة. فرص تدريب وتطوير مهني.

962994b002b2f940.description: About the Role Cigalah Group is seeking a Trade Marketing Manager to join their team. This full-time position is based in either Jeddah or Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on developing and executing trade marketing strategies to drive sales and profitability across various channels. Key Accountabilities The Trade Marketing Manager will be responsible for several core areas that contribute to commercial success and operational efficiency: Developing channel and customer strategies. Managing commercial negotiations and controls. Overseeing in-store execution. Collaborating on demand and supply initiatives. Handling principal and people management. Core Responsibilities Key duties for this role include strategic planning and development within the retail sector: Setting modern trade sales, volume, profitability, distribution, and investment plans for each customer and principal. Developing national and regional retail chains through customer segmentation, joint business plans, and store expansion initiatives. Commercial Management and Oversight The role requires active management of commercial agreements and financial performance: Leading annual trading agreements, BDAs, rebates, listings, promotional, and visibility terms. Ensuring customer contracts are documented, approved, and financially viable. Tracking customer contribution, gross-to-net, promotional ROI, and claim reconciliation. Key Performance Indicators Performance in this role will be measured against specific metrics, including: Sales/volume versus target. Customer contribution and trade-spend ROI. JBP delivery and new listings. On-shelf availability and assortment compliance. OTIF, returns, and forecast accuracy. Claims ageing and DSO. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess extensive experience and a strong understanding of distributor governance requirements: A minimum of 12 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability in multi-principal delivery, including distinct brand/principal commitments alongside integrated distributor resource deployment. Experience with decision rights, documenting authority for customer terms, pricing, promotions, credit, and trade investments. Proficiency in channel ownership, defining customer segmentation and channel boundaries to avoid MT/TT/Wholesale overlap. Strong financial discipline, including signed agreements, approved discounts, claim substantiation, and customer profitability visibility. Commitment to execution transparency, ensuring consistent sell-in, sell-out, distribution, inventory, and outlet execution reporting.

96f85e5140069b05.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة Armada International Corporation عن رسام معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد المخططات التنفيذية التفصيلية ومطابقة المخططات المعمارية مع مخططات الكهروميكانيك، بالإضافة إلى مهام أخرى تتعلق بالتشطيبات الداخلية والديكور. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 1-4 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد المخططات التنفيذية التفصيلية (Shop Drawings) لجميع أعمال التشطيبات الداخلية والديكور، بما في ذلك الأسقف المستعارة، القواطع الجدارية، الأرضيات، التجاليد الخشبية والمعدنية، وتفاصيل الواجهات الداخلية. مطابقة وتنسيق المخططات المعمارية مع مخططات الكهروميكانيك (MEP Coordination) لضمان عدم وجود أي تعارضات قبل وأثناء التنفيذ الميداني. رسم وإخراج تفاصيل التركيبات والتشطيبات الخاصة (Interior Details & Joinery) وفق متطلبات المكاتب والمباني الإدارية الحكومية. إعداد ومتابعة مخططات ما بعد التنفيذ (As-Built) وتقديمها للاعتماد النهائي. مراجعة وحصر الكميات وجداول التشطيبات والفرش بالتنسيق مع المكتب الفني ومهندسي الموقع. إدارة ومتابعة سجلات المخططات (Drawing Log) وتحديث الإصدارات المعتمدة ومشاركتها مع فرق العمل بالموقع. المؤهلات والمتطلبات عضوية هيئة المهندسين. مؤهل علمي في تخصص (رسم معماري، دبلوم هندسة معمارية، أو ما يعادله). خبرة عملية لا تقل عن سنة إلى 4 سنوات في مجال التشطيبات الداخلية (Fit-Out)، ويُفضل من لديه خبرة مباشرة في مشاريع المباني الإدارية أو المقرات الحكومية. المهارات التقنية إتقان تام لبرامج: AutoCAD و Revit (ميزة إضافية) وبرامج النمذجة ثلاثية الأبعاد ذات العلاقة. فهم شامل للمواد والمواصفات القياسية لأعمال التشطيبات الداخلية (Drywall, Flooring, Joinery, Acoustic Ceilings). دراية بمعايير المكاتب الاستشارية وإجراءات الاعتماد الفني المتبعة في المشاريع الحكومية. تفاصيل إضافية الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور يتراوح بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، والمسمى الوظيفي هو رسام معماري.

965c70853b71b878.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة بن جار الله لإدارة المرافق عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات المطلوبة مع مطابقة مواصفاتها. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل دارات التمديدات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. فهم جيد لمخططات التمديدات الكهربائية وقدرة على قراءتها وتطبيقها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. بيئة العمل يعمل الفني الكهربائي ضمن فريق شركة مجموعة بن جار الله لإدارة المرافق في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة المهنية في جميع الأوقات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في الرياض.

9697b1e2054e7a62.description: المهام خدمة العملاء وتجربة العميل: • الرد على العميلات في قنوات التواصل. • متابعة الطلبات والشكاوى حتى إغلاقها، والتنسيق مع المخزون. • تحديث الردود المعتمدة لكل حملة. • رصد الملاحظات والأسئلة المتكررة، ونقل ما تطلبه العميلات إلى الفريق. • رفع تحليل أسبوعي لخدمة العملاء وتجربة العميل. الرد الآلي بالذكاء الاصطناعي: • تدريب AI على الرد على العملاء، ومتابعة ردوده وتحسينها. المؤثرات و UGC: • التواصل اليومي مع المؤثرات وصناع UGC. • جمع صناع UGC المناسبين وتسليمهم البريف. • متابعة إرسال المنتجات واستلام المحتوى. • تأكيد توحيد الكلمات وتاريخ الإطلاق. تيك توك: • تطبيق الاستراتيجية المعتمدة والنشر على حساب a'mie حسب التقويم.

9674a13ed507bafc.description: About the Role Ninja is seeking an experienced MEP Designer to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves developing, reviewing, and maintaining electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and building-services designs for both new and existing stores. The successful candidate will ensure that all engineering designs adhere to safety standards, operational requirements, cost-efficiency objectives, and long-term maintainability. Key Responsibilities Prepare and review MEP drawings, technical specifications, equipment schedules, and engineering calculations. Develop electrical load calculations, single-line diagrams, cable sizing, lighting, and power layouts. Perform HVAC cooling load calculations, AC sizing, ventilation requirements, and refrigeration design reviews. Coordinate plumbing, drainage, fire alarm, and fire protection requirements with relevant specialists. Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQs), material specifications, and technical comparisons. Review contractor submissions and drawings, inspect installations, and support testing, commissioning, and handover processes. Maintain standardized engineering documentation, as-built drawings, asset schedules, and warranty records. Identify opportunities to optimize construction costs, energy consumption, and maintenance expenses. Ensure compliance with applicable Saudi codes and company engineering standards. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of experience in MEP design or a related field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on quick-commerce store infrastructure.

96adc70014da1977.company_name: SAMREF Saudi Aramco Mobil Refinery Company Ltd.
96adc70014da1977.description: About the Role SAMREF Saudi Aramco Mobil Refinery Company Ltd. is seeking an OT Network Engineer to join their team in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the secure, reliable, and continuous operation of the refinery’s Plant Automation Network (PAN) and associated Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity controls. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and plays a vital role in protecting refinery operations from cyber threats, ensuring uninterrupted production, plant safety, and regulatory compliance. Role Purpose and Context The OT Network Engineer is responsible for maintaining the availability, integrity, and security of OT networks that support process control, safety systems, and overall plant operations. This includes adherence to applicable industry standards, corporate cybersecurity requirements, and audit obligations. The role ensures that cybersecurity controls are implemented effectively without compromising plant safety or operational continuity. Key Responsibilities Administer, operate, and maintain the OT Plant Automation Network, including industrial switches, firewalls, and communication infrastructure for DCS, PLCs, SCADA, and SIS. Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of OT networks supporting 24/7 plant operations. Maintain secure network segmentation and controlled connectivity between OT and external systems. Administer user and service accounts for OT systems, enforcing password control, privilege management, and segregation of duties. Implement and maintain OT cybersecurity controls such as logging, monitoring, antivirus, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and baseline configuration control. Plan and execute scheduled OT antivirus updates and patching activities, coordinating to minimize production impact. Conduct OT cybersecurity risk assessments for new and existing systems and maintain accurate OT asset inventory and licensing records. Support internal and external OT cybersecurity assessments and audits, developing and tracking corrective action plans. Provide emergency call-out support for OT cybersecurity incidents and participate in investigations, containment, and recovery efforts. Manage and control OT firewalls, network access rules, and secure remote connectivity, monitoring network traffic for anomalies. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in OT network engineering or a related field. Demonstrated understanding of industrial control systems (DCS, PLCs, SCADA, SIS) and their network requirements. Familiarity with industry standards such as ISA/IEC 62443. Experience with network administration, firewall management, and cybersecurity controls implementation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, within a critical refinery operation environment. The role involves supporting 24/7 plant operations and responding to cybersecurity incidents as part of an on-call schedule. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

9626b3222bdda740.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البيوت العصرية للديكور عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة التسويات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، والتأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات اللازمة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند الضرورة. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بترحيب وتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل في التعاملات المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة المهام اليومية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في المدينة المنورة، ويكون الدوام بنظام الدوام الكامل. ستعمل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء والزملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة البيوت العصرية للديكور والمساهمة في تقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة للعملاء.

964fef4328c0ed21.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking an experienced Sales Manager - Diesel Generators to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Riyadh, or Jeddah and requires a professional with a strong background in power solutions. Role Overview The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving sales and business development for diesel generators and power solutions across various key sectors. This role involves strategic planning, customer relationship management, and project oversight to achieve revenue and growth objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets. Drive business development across Oil & Gas, Construction, Industrial, Infrastructure, Data Centers, Rental, and Government sectors. Develop and maintain relationships with key customers, consultants, contractors, and EPC companies. Manage major projects, tenders, commercial negotiations, and key accounts. Provide technical and commercial guidance on diesel generators and power solutions. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and new business opportunities. Coordinate with engineering, service, and operations teams to ensure customer satisfaction. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field. 10-12 years of overall experience in diesel generator sales, power generation, or power solutions. Minimum of 4-5 years of experience in Saudi Arabia in a Sales Manager or equivalent sales leadership position. Strong technical and commercial knowledge of generator systems, including generator sizing, synchronization, AMF/ATS, and power solutions. Experience with brands such as Cummins, Perkins, FG Wilson, Mitsubishi, MTU, Volvo Penta, Kohler, AKSA, Caterpillar, or similar brands is preferred. Proven track record in business development, team management, key account management, and achieving sales targets. Excellent communication, negotiation, and client relationship management skills. A Saudi driving license is preferred. Compensation The salary for this position is SAR 13,000-14,000 per month, offered as an all-inclusive package. Location This role is based in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, with primary locations in Dammam, Riyadh, or Jeddah.

9689458891ca7106.description: About the Role UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company is seeking a Lead Planner to oversee all staff planning and ensure the application of best practices in project controls and planning across all projects. This full-time role involves highlighting overall progress, delays, and areas of concern to management, and providing support for delay analysis and complex project controls issues. Key Responsibilities Oversee all project planning staff and activities, ensuring consistent application of planning and project controls best practices and compliance with company standards. Develop, review, and maintain integrated project schedules for engineering, procurement, construction, and start-up activities, ensuring schedule integrity through baseline control and change management. Monitor overall project progress and performance, identifying key risks, delays, and variances, and preparing progress dashboards, KPI reports, and executive summaries for senior management. Prepare and manage manpower forecasts and revenue projections aligned with approved schedules and project execution plans, monitoring daily manpower requirements. Support projects with schedule risk assessments, delay analysis, and extension of time (EOT) evaluations, providing expert planning input on complex project controls issues and recovery strategies. Review technical documents, programs, and workshop scopes to understand planning and execution impacts, and prepare planning-related responses to formal correspondence. Coordinate planning interfaces between engineering, procurement, construction, cost control, and site teams to ensure schedule alignment and resolve constraints. Ensure effective use of planning systems and tools, including Primavera P6 and ERP platforms like SAP, supporting data integration and reporting consistency. Support HSE initiatives and ensure planning activities align with safety, quality, and cost objectives, participating in safety awareness and incident reporting. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 8 years of working experience. At least 5 years of relevant working experience in a planning role. 2 years of GCC experience is preferred. Work Type This is a full-time position.

96c33843bd0df7c6.description: About KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive and value-driven solutions across the entire asset lifecycle. This includes providing world-class licensed process technologies, specialized advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions aimed at optimizing both planned and operational assets. Role Overview: Bus Driver KBR is seeking a Bus Driver to join our team in Makkah, with operations covering cities such as Rabigh and Makkah. This full-time role involves the safe and timely transportation of various materials, which may include supplies, hazardous chemicals, or manufacturing equipment. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience and demonstrate a strong commitment to safety and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Transport cargo efficiently from one location to another for distribution, purchase, or sale. Conduct thorough safety inspections of vehicles and adhere strictly to all safety instructions, particularly when handling hazardous materials or chemicals. Maintain responsibility for the vehicle's condition, identifying and reporting any malfunctioning parts. Inspect cargo to ensure it has been loaded correctly and securely. Review all necessary shipping documents to ensure accuracy and compliance. Ensure full compliance with all established safety procedures. Promote and encourage the reporting of unsafe acts and conditions within the workplace. Comply with all Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) procedures both prior to and during work activities. Required Qualifications and Skills Candidates must be in good physical condition, capable of extended periods on the road. Possess knowledge of vehicle maintenance to address potential breakdowns. Demonstrate punctuality and adherence to schedules to ensure timely transportation of materials. Exhibit careful attention and strict adherence to precautionary measures when transporting hazardous or fragile materials. A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a similar driving role is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, involving travel between cities such as Rabigh and Makkah. The role requires a strong focus on safety and adherence to operational protocols, particularly when handling diverse cargo types.

96c6485616d7d4af.description: About the Role Aramco Stadium is seeking a Director, Commercial Strategy to lead the commercial strategy across all revenue streams. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, and involves shaping the company strategy and business plan in collaboration with the Chief Executive Officer, Chief Commercial Officer, and Chief Financial Officer. The role focuses on commercial planning, pricing strategy, and deal governance across various business lines, including ticketing, premium hospitality, sponsorship, events, and ancillary products. Role Purpose and Outcomes The Director, Commercial Strategy will lead the Strategy team, setting revenue targets by business line and governing major commercial deals. This role is responsible for translating sales, sponsorship, and market analysis into decisions that drive sustained revenue growth. The primary outcome is to deliver a commercial strategy that maximizes revenue across every business line, ensuring the company business plan is aligned with executive leadership, targets are set and tracked, and profitability is protected through effective pricing and deal governance. The role also involves identifying, negotiating, and bringing new business opportunities to market around the venue. Key Responsibilities Direct the preparation of the company strategy and multi-year business plan, supporting executive leadership and presenting to the executive team and the board. Define strategic priorities and track the delivery of related initiatives. Own the consolidated annual and multi-year commercial plan, setting revenue targets across all verticals in coordination with respective directors. Manage periodic reforecasting cycles and present regular performance reports on all commercial verticals to leadership. Track top-line sales, sponsorship returns, capital investment performance, and profitability against KPIs, including return on investment analysis for proposed capital improvements. Define the pricing strategy across all commercial revenue streams, including price tiers, dynamic and seasonal frameworks, and promotions. Analyze demand, pricing performance, customer insights, and competitor offerings to optimize yield and identify new revenue opportunities. Set deal review standards across all commercial verticals and validate the terms, profitability, and strategic fit of major deals and sponsorships. Govern discounts and pricing exceptions within the delegated authority framework and support commercial policies, procedures, and controls. Identify and assess adjacencies and new businesses around the venue, developing business cases for leadership approval. Originate, structure, and negotiate partnerships and major commercial agreements with partners, tenants, and operators. Partner with Programming to shape the event calendar based on per-event profitability analysis, maximizing commercial returns. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to lead commercial strategy across multiple revenue streams. Experience in commercial planning, pricing strategy, and deal governance. Proven track record in identifying and negotiating growth opportunities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, within Aramco Stadium. The role requires collaboration with executive leadership and various departmental directors to achieve commercial objectives.

9616ba596088912b.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Cost Control Engineer to join their team in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience, with a salary range of SAR 5000 - 7000. The role focuses on cost control within the Oil & Gas sector, particularly for EPC and Shutdown & Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. Key Responsibilities Manage and monitor project costs effectively. Prepare and submit accurate cost reports. Ensure cost control measures align with project objectives. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant technical qualification. 5-8 years of experience in the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Refinery industry. Hands-on experience with Primavera P6. Strong English communication and reporting skills. Preferred Experience Experience with EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects. Experience in Shutdown & Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. Previous work experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC region. Additional certification in Cost Control, Project Controls, or Quantity Surveying. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, and involves working within the dynamic Oil & Gas sector. The role requires a professional who can effectively manage costs and contribute to project success in a demanding environment. Application Information Candidates must possess relevant experience that directly matches the requirements of this Cost Control Engineer position. Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

963d52964f971c50.description: About the Role Abdul Hadi Abdullah Al-Qahtani & Sons Beverage Company (AQS-PEPSI) is seeking a Finance Wholesale Commercial Supervisor to join their team in Abha, 'Asir. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves leading the Wholesale & Local Commercial Credit team, focusing on financial governance and credit management. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to lead the Wholesale & Local Commercial Credit team, overseeing rebate and accrual governance, credit utilization, and AR reconciliation. The supervisor is responsible for driving the timely resolution of overdue balances, calculating Expected Credit Loss (ECL), and ensuring that the team's credit decisions support cash flow while enabling sustainable sales targets. Key Responsibilities Lead and develop the Credit Analyst team. Govern wholesale and local customer rebates and accruals. Control wholesale/local credit utilization. Ensure accurate Accounts Receivable (AR) reconciliation. Perform monthly analysis of Balance Sheet commercial General Ledger (GL) accounts. Review and adjust customer accruals against contracts on a monthly basis. Review daily pricing and D&A updates for compliance with company Statement of Authority (SOA). Provide monthly Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and Days Cash Sales Outstanding (DCSO) analysis with Causes of Change (COCs). Provide monthly D&A reports by customer, material, amount, and accrual type. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Previous supervisory or team leadership experience. Experience within the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) or distribution sectors. Experience managing rebates, accruals, customer contracts, and credit risk assessments. Proficiency with SAP ERP and GTM systems. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Abha, 'Asir, within Abdul Hadi Abdullah Al-Qahtani & Sons Beverage Company (AQS-PEPSI). The role involves leading a dedicated team and collaborating with various internal stakeholders to achieve financial objectives. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this position. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

This full-time role involves developing and maintaining strategic customer relationships and proactively identifying solutions that add value to customers. The position is integral to driving offering and sales development strategies within the team. Key Responsibilities Proactively develop and create customer relationships within the assigned area of responsibility. Accountable for developing KONE's market position within the customer base or market area. Generate and communicate leads and sales opportunities for the entire KONE sales team, including cross-selling. Ensure customer satisfaction and resolve complaints in collaboration with the KONE team. Document customer and contact information, maintaining accurate customer data. Generate opportunities from outside the current customer base. Handle Requests for Quotation (RFQs). Accountable for leads, opportunities, orders, and contracts to meet sales budget and pricing targets. Identify customer needs and ensure KONE's solutions align with those needs. Responsible for pricing using approved tendering tools and optimizing prices and discounts within authority. Validate that contract contents are in line with negotiation outcomes. Maintain comprehensive information on opportunities, tasks, and visits (sales funnel management). Responsible for timely and accurate reporting in CRM. Gather relevant market and competitor information from the field. Support the finance function in money collection. Drive the execution of individual sales plans. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop mutually beneficial relationships with strategic customers. Proven capability to proactively identify solutions and develop value-adding processes for customers. Work Environment and Culture KONE fosters an innovative and collaborative working culture that values individual contributions. Employee engagement is a key focus, encouraging participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is integrated into the culture and daily practices, alongside ethical business practices. The company promotes a culture of trust, respect, and recognition for good performance, offering opportunities for career and personal development. Compensation and Benefits KONE offers a comprehensive total rewards package, including both financial and non-financial benefits, designed to recognize performance and support employee engagement. The company is committed to fairness, respect, equity, diversity, and inclusion.

969700cd0d6ca4d7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخليج المعدنية للتعدين عن كهربائي مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح الأسلاك الكهربائية والأجهزة والتجهيزات في المباني، بالإضافة إلى فحص الأعطال الكهربائية ومعالجتها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المعدات الكهربائية في المباني، بما في ذلك الكابلات والأسلاك والأجهزة الكهربائية الأخرى. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية لتحديد الأضرار التي قد تلحق بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال المعدات الكهربائية المعطلة مثل الكابلات والأسلاك والأجهزة. استخدام مجموعة متنوعة من الأدوات اليدوية والمعدات الأساسية اللازمة لإنجاز المهام. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال كهرباء المباني. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح الأنظمة الكهربائية المختلفة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة الكهربائية. بيئة العمل يعمل كهربائي المباني ضمن فريق متخصص في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل في بيئة تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية قوية في التعامل مع الأنظمة الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وإصلاحها بفعالية. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة الخليج المعدنية للتعدين.

96b9df2eec810cbf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابو زايد انترناشونال للخبز عن مشرف تنظيف وتدبير للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على أنشطة التدبير في المرافق التجارية وتنسيقها وتنفيذها، لضمان الحفاظ على المرافق مرتبة ونظيفة بشكل مستمر. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الجداول الزمنية لخدمات التنظيف والتدبير. تخطيط وإعداد الجداول الزمنية الخاصة بأعمال الموظفين. الإشراف المباشر على الموظفين أثناء أدائهم لواجباتهم اليومية، والتي تشمل مسح الأتربة، كنس الأرضيات، تنظيف دورات المياه، وتغيير الشراشف. الحث على تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي المعتمدة. مراقبة مخزون إمدادات التنظيف والمعدات والإمدادات الأخرى، والحفاظ عليه لضمان توفرها. اتباع وتطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة في جميع الأنشطة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الإشراف على التنظيف أو التدبير المنزلي. القدرة على إدارة الجداول الزمنية وتنسيق المهام بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في الإشراف على فريق العمل وتوجيهه. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المرافق التجارية للإشراف المباشر على عمليات التنظيف والتدبير. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة ابو زايد انترناشونال للخبز، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

9614dab0ffa444ba.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات عن مهندس أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة وصيانة الأجهزة الطبية، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج تركيب الأجهزة الطبية، مثل أجهزة التصوير الإشعاعي والموجي وأجهزة التشخيص والمعالجة. تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة الطبية بكفاءة. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الطبية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إجراء الفحوص اللازمة للتأكد من دقة أداء الأجهزة الطبية. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وعرض نسب تقدمها وتوضيحها. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال هندسة الأجهزة الطبية. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق تعليمات الشركات المصنعة للأجهزة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومقره في مدينة حائل، ويوفر فرصة للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال أنظمة المعلومات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء الصيانة. القدرة على تدريب المستخدمين وتقديم الدعم الفني. مهارات إعداد التقارير والتوثيق الفني. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

96509ed342ad444d.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform designed for emerging markets. With over 25 years of conversational AI research and development, the company serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA. Unifonic is pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. Recognized as a Great Place to Work®, Unifonic operates with a focus on creativity, collaboration, and innovation. The Role of Corporate Operations Specialist Unifonic is seeking a Corporate Operations Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves managing daily HR operations, government relations (GRO), local labor compliance, office administration, and vendor management. The specialist will serve as the primary operational anchor for the Saudi Arabia team, ensuring smooth onboarding, full regulatory compliance across government portals, and comprehensive employee support. Key Responsibilities Manage relationships with Saudi regulatory authorities, ensuring full compliance with Saudi Labor Law. Execute operational tasks on government portals, including Qiwa, Mudad, Muqeem, and GOSI. Handle the end-to-end Iqama process, including new issuance, renewals, and exit/re-entry visa processing. Lead business visa and work visa processing for new joiners and visitors to the Saudi Arabia office. Ensure timely renewal of all company official documents, licenses, and commercial registrations. Address employee requests and inquiries across offices, providing resolutions within designated SLAs. Oversee medical insurance administration, including employee additions, deletions, tier updates, and policy renewals. Support onboarding workflows and administrative setup for new joiners in Saudi Arabia. Maintain Saudi office facilities, manage office supplies and inventory, and ensure a professional workspace. Manage petty cash handling, tracking, and monthly reconciliation. Process vendor invoices, ensuring accurate record-keeping and timely processing. Build and maintain relationships with vendors, landlords, and service providers. Arrange business travel logistics for team members, including flight bookings, hotel accommodations, local transportation, per diem management, and event coordination. Required Character Traits Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving: Ability to approach problems clearly, utilize data, and identify solutions. Ownership and Accountability: Taking responsibility and ensuring project completion. Communication: Clearly articulating ideas and actively listening across teams. Collaboration: Working effectively with others to support team objectives. Adaptability and Learning: Adjusting to changes and continuously acquiring new skills or tools. Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Supporting the growth of others and sharing expertise. Resilience: Maintaining composure under pressure and addressing setbacks constructively. Quality and Attention to Detail: Executing work meticulously and striving for continuous improvement. Advocacy and Innovation: Promoting best practices, efficiency, and new ideas. Work Environment The People Department at Unifonic focuses on attracting, developing, and retaining talent. The department is committed to fostering a positive and inclusive work environment, ensuring that all colleagues feel valued, supported, and empowered. This role contributes to all aspects of people operations, including recruiting, onboarding, training, and development, while promoting a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

968d5437ca9bf5ba.company_name: شركة فوزى محمود ابو ضيف محمد للصناعة
968d5437ca9bf5ba.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فوزى محمود ابو ضيف محمد للصناعة عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى المساعد الإداري مسؤولية متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر، وتنظيم أعمال البريد والمواعيد، وإنجاز الأعمال الإدارية المتعلقة بسير العمل. كما يشمل الدور تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر لضمان سلاسة التواصل والفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على المعنيين، وفتح البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقاً لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم الملفات الخاصة. حفظ المعاملات والعناية بالملفات بأسلوب يسهل عملية الرجوع إليها. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها، وطباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر للأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة البريد والمواعيد. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية قوية. القدرة على تنظيم وتنسيق الاجتماعات بكفاءة. مهارات الطباعة وحفظ الملفات بشكل منظم. القدرة على التعامل مع الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية بمهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل المساعد الإداري بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة بمكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق يدعم العمليات الإدارية لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة وفعالية.

96edf8c92cbfbb7d.description: About the Role UCC Holding is seeking an experienced Procurement Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves managing the procurement of materials, equipment, and subcontract packages for large-scale construction projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring timely delivery of materials in line with project schedules and budget requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage the procurement process for construction materials, equipment, and subcontract works. Review project specifications, drawings, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and material requirements. Prepare and issue Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and Requests for Proposal (RFPs) to approved vendors and subcontractors. Conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations. Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, payment terms, and contractual conditions. Prepare comparison statements and procurement recommendations for management approval. Coordinate with engineering, planning, commercial, and site teams to ensure procurement requirements are met. Expedite the delivery of materials and equipment to meet project schedules. Monitor supplier performance and maintain vendor relationships. Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and project requirements. Track procurement status and prepare periodic procurement reports. Identify cost-saving opportunities through value engineering and strategic sourcing. Resolve supply chain and delivery issues that may impact project progress. Support subcontractor prequalification and vendor registration activities. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Architectural Engineering. Minimum of 7-10 years of procurement experience in construction projects. Experience with Tier-1 Main Contractors is preferred. Strong knowledge of procurement procedures, contract administration, and supply chain management. Experience procuring construction materials, MEP equipment, finishing materials, and subcontract packages. Required Skills Good understanding of technical specifications and construction methodologies. Proficiency in ERP systems, including SAP and Oracle, and MS Office applications. Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to work on large-scale construction projects with UCC Holding.

9666302dd007397e.description: About Galderma and the Role Galderma is a pure-play dermatology category leader operating in approximately 90 countries. The company delivers a science-based portfolio of brands and services across Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare, and Therapeutic Dermatology. This role is for a Market Access & Pricing Lead based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offered on a contract basis. The successful candidate will be instrumental in shaping market access and pricing strategies for the Saudi portfolio. Key Responsibilities Develop and manage the national market access, pricing, and reimbursement strategy for the Saudi portfolio, aligning with business objectives, regional pricing governance, and Vision 2030 Health Sector Transformation Program. Translate strategy into executable national, cluster, account, tender, and stakeholder plans with defined owners, timelines, and KPIs. Manage Saudi price positioning within the international price referencing system, considering the Kingdom’s role as a reference country and regional price alignment. Design innovative access solutions, including managed entry agreements, outcomes-based and risk-sharing agreements, price-volume agreements, and patient access programs. Lead pre-launch market shaping activities, including mapping national payers and policy stakeholders, aligning access planning with Regulatory Affairs, and identifying Saudi-specific evidence gaps. Define launch price corridors and lead SFDA pricing submissions, ensuring consistency with international reference pricing and global launch sequencing. Drive post-launch access optimization by securing listings on Ministry of Health and institutional formularies, and expanding inclusion across various health sectors. Manage SFDA price re-evaluations, price reviews, and lifecycle events, and lead loss-of-exclusivity planning. Oversee national tender strategy for NUPCO unified procurement, long-term agreements, and direct institutional purchases, ensuring compliance with local content requirements. Lead HEOR initiatives, localization of global value dossiers, budget impact, and cost-effectiveness models in line with national health technology assessment requirements. Lead pricing and reimbursement negotiations with SFDA, NUPCO, the Ministry of Health, health clusters, and institutional payers. Build compliant relationships with key Saudi healthcare stakeholders and monitor the healthcare environment for policy changes. Partner cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, and Compliance teams, representing market access on the Country Leadership Team. Serve as the primary market access subject matter expert in Saudi Arabia and the in-country point of contact for regional and global pricing committees. Ensure all access, pricing, and stakeholder activities comply with SFDA regulations, the Saudi anti-bribery framework, and company compliance policies. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to build and execute national market access, pricing, and reimbursement strategies. Experience in managing price positioning within international referencing systems. Proficiency in designing innovative access solutions. Experience in pre-launch market shaping, including stakeholder engagement and evidence generation. Knowledge of SFDA pricing submissions and regulatory requirements. Experience in post-launch access optimization and managing lifecycle events. Strong background in institutional business, tenders, and contracting, including compliance with local content requirements. Expertise in HEOR initiatives, value evidence, and negotiation with payers. Proven ability to build trusted relationships with key healthcare stakeholders and anticipate policy changes. Experience in cross-functional leadership and partnership within a global organization. Work Environment and Culture Galderma values individuals who are results-oriented, embrace learning, and bring positive energy. The company fosters an environment that combines initiative with teamwork and collaboration. Employees are empowered, and personal growth is promoted while ensuring business needs are met. Diversity is embraced, and the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee are respected. Professionalism, collaboration, and a supportive ethos are central to the work culture.

96fe2dbf12e7bb8a.job_title: Field Specialist II Tubular Services (TBL) (Field Supervisor TRS)
96fe2dbf12e7bb8a.description: About the Role NES Global Talent is seeking a Field Specialist II - Tubular Services (TBL) or Tubular Running Services (TRS) Field Supervisor for a contract position based in Dhahran and Dammam. This mid-level technical oilfield role is responsible for the management, maintenance, and operation of tubular equipment on rig floors, supervision of field crews, and ensuring adherence to safety and service quality standards. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and execute the safe makeup, breakout, installation, and running of tubulars, including casing, tubing, and accessories, at onshore or offshore rig sites. Perform hands-on installation, troubleshooting, testing, and routine servicing of TRS equipment both in the shop and on location. Supervise, train, and manage field operators and assistant crews during rig-up, operation, and rig-down tasks. Participate in daily safety meetings, Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), and toolbox talks, ensuring strict compliance with company and client Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) guidelines. Required Experience and Skills Minimum of 5 to 10 years of hands-on field experience in oil and gas wellsite or tubular running services, with 6 to 8+ years of active field experience on onshore or offshore drilling rigs. Deep proficiency in running casing and tubing strings, operating hydraulic power tongs and CRTi tools, performing rig-up/rig-down operations, torque-turn data monitoring, and executing field equipment maintenance and troubleshooting. Ability to lead teams, act as a primary interface with the client (Company Man), and oversee high-risk, high-cost casing and tubing operations on the rig floor. Proficiency with tools and software related to managing hydraulic power tongs, computerized torque-turn monitoring, and casing drive systems. Qualifications and Certifications Standard industry safety and operational certifications are required. Candidates must meet a specific combination of technical competencies, field safety certifications, and physical requirements. Work Environment This is a contract position involving field operations at onshore or offshore rig sites in the Dhahran and Dammam regions. The role requires active participation in rig-floor operations and adherence to stringent safety protocols. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary information is not disclosed at this time.

96352ffdb12bc685.description: About the Role Schneider Electric is seeking an HR Officer to join the Labour and Social Relations team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting workplace relationships, assisting with collective bargaining, resolving employee concerns, and ensuring compliance with labor laws. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Assist in negotiating and managing collective bargaining agreements with union partners. Support the resolution of employee grievances and workplace disputes through mediation and clear documentation. Help ensure compliance with labor laws and regulations to protect the organization and its people. Coordinate training programs that build conflict resolution and labor relations capabilities across teams. Qualifications and Skills Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with diverse stakeholders. A proactive mindset with attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Emotional intelligence to navigate sensitive conversations with empathy and professionalism. Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a dynamic environment. Professional Development This role offers professional development opportunities in labor relations, compliance, and conflict resolution. Training programs are designed to expand skills and support career advancement within a collaborative team environment that values contributions and growth. 9682018b3ec00c86.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عمر مبارك سالم الجوهي عن مدير مبيعات جملة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق العمليات في متجر البيع بالجملة، بالإضافة إلى إدارة العلاقات مع الموردين وتجار التجزئة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان الأداء الفعال للمتجر وتحقيق النمو التجاري. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة العمليات اليومية لمتجر البيع بالجملة، مع ضمان الاستخدام الأمثل للموارد المتاحة. الإشراف على تخطيط شؤون الموظفين وتدريبهم لضمان كفاءة الأداء. مراقبة مستويات المخزون وضمان طلب المنتجات في الوقت المناسب. الإشراف على مناولة المنتجات الواردة بشكل فوري لتخزينها أو عرضها. مراقبة الأداء العام لمتجر البيع بالجملة، وتحليل الموازنات والمبيعات ومؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية. وضع وتنفيذ الخطط الترويجية والإعلانية بهدف تعزيز النمو التجاري. إدارة شكاوى العملاء وحل النزاعات المحتملة بعد تصعيدها إلى مستوى المدير. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة المبيعات بالجملة أو العمليات التجارية. القدرة على إدارة الموازنات والموظفين والأداء العام للمتجر. مهارات قوية في إدارة العلاقات مع الموردين وتجار التجزئة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التواجد في متجر البيع بالجملة لإدارة العمليات اليومية بشكل مباشر. نظرة عامة على الوظيفة المسمى الوظيفي: مدير مبيعات جملة الشركة: شركة عمر مبارك سالم الجوهي الموقع: الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الخبرة المطلوبة: 2-5 سنوات الراتب: غير معلن التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة عمر مبارك سالم الجوهي، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

9689778c7d3b8448.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems is the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor, operating under Government-to-Government agreements to provide equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia. The company is responsible for the maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and for training RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel in the safe use of aircraft, equipment, and weapons. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia supports the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capabilities through partnerships and industrialisation. Role Overview: Weapons Director (WD) Pilot Control Unit (PCU) Operator CAT II This full-time position is for a Weapons Director (WD) Pilot Control Unit (PCU) Operator CAT II based in Al Majma'ah. The role involves functioning as a PCU Operator within the Air Traffic Control (ATC) and Weapons Director sections, providing realistic simulations for air traffic controller and weapons director training programs at the King Fahad Air Academy (KFAA). The operator will deliver Aerodrome, Non-Radar Approach Control, and Radar Approach Control Simulations, as well as Weapons Director Simulations. Key Responsibilities Operate as a PCU Operator ATC/WD to provide realistic simulations in 2D/3D Visual Tower, Radar Approach, Non-Radar Approach Control, and Weapons Director simulations. Assist in preparing visual aids and daily mission briefings for students, specifically for WD requirements. Support in-house demonstrations of ATC/WD simulator operations, including aircraft and vehicle models, airspace data, weather, and operational exercises. Maintain cross-training and currency for both PCU Operator ATC and WD specialities in simulator operations within the Technical Studies Department. Instruct cadets on simulator equipment, aircraft keyboard inputs, R/T phraseology, and ATC/WD operations. Address issues related to ATC/WD simulator operations in accordance with ICAO, GACA, and RSAF ATC & WD procedures. Assist with data input into the Learning Content Management System (LCMS) and the development, programming, editing, and implementation of practical exercises on ATC/WD simulators. Contribute to the review and amendment of Simulator Support Staff training material and procedures, and assist with the production of ATC/WD training manuals. Carry out administrative duties as assigned by the Head of Department (HOD) and provide feedback to management for service improvement. Maintain accurate training records using the TMIS/LMS system and contribute to the maintenance of training resources. Assist with the preparation and testing of Mission/Exercise Simulator and Skills trainer exercises, quizzes, examinations, and teaching aids. Ensure compliance with Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) policy and processes, and Duty of Care responsibilities. Undertake all mandatory and developmental training and complete annual Electronic Personnel Development Reviews (E-PDR). Qualifications and Experience For Pilot Control Unit Operator – Air Traffic Control (ATC) CAT II: Demonstrated Air Traffic Control Simulator Operations experience within ATC Simulations at an Academic, Aviation Training Organization, or Air Navigation Service Provider. Completion of a recognised Air Traffic Control Simulator Operators Course, or the Company SNTTP ATC PCU Intern Course. A minimum of three years’ experience in an Air Traffic Control Training Department. Knowledge and experience of ATC Regulations, Procedures, and Flight Deck Operations. Pilot with a minimum of 500 operational flying hours and certified as a Simulator Instructor. For Weapons Director (WD) CAT II: Demonstrated Weapons Director Simulator Operations experience within Weapons Director Simulations at an Academic or Aviation Training Organization. Completion of a recognised Weapons Director Simulator Operators Course, or the Company SNTTP Pilot Control Unit (PCU) Weapons Director Intern Course. A minimum of three years’ experience as a Pilot Control Unit (PCU) Operator in Weapons Director training. Knowledge and experience of Weapons Director regulations and procedures, and Flight Deck Operations. Pilot with a minimum of 500 operational flying hours and certified as a Simulator Instructor. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Majma'ah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a training environment that encourages independent learning and a military ethos, ensuring adherence to acceptable standards of behaviour, dress, and performance as defined in company policy. Compensation A competitive salary is offered for this role, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

96963317952db4ee.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرفاد للمقاولات عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الأحساء بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب هذا الدور سائقاً ذا خبرة في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة، ملتزماً بمعايير السلامة والتشغيل. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة والالتزام بالمسارات المحددة وفقاً لخطط العمل. التقيد التام بقواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، مع الحرص على عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على الشاحنة ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تطرأ عليها. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة التي تتطلب فحصاً من الخبراء عند ملاحظة أي خلل فني. الالتزام الكامل بأدلة الإجراءات والمواصفات والمعايير، بالإضافة إلى سياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة. حيازة رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول تتناسب مع نوع الشاحنة المطلوبة. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للشاحنة ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المرورية والتشغيلية. بيئة العمل والمزايا يعمل سائق الشاحنة الصغيرة ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية في شركة الرفاد للمقاولات بالأحساء. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير تأمين طبي للموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة المعمول بها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويوفر فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق ملتزم بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. معلومات إضافية تعتبر هذه الوظيفة فرصة للمرشحين الذين يمتلكون الخبرة والكفاءة في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة والالتزام بالمعايير المهنية. لم يتم الكشف عن الراتب لهذا الدور.

96be6acc23d1a737.description: About the Role Hala is seeking a Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst to join the Group FP&A team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role is suited for an experienced finance professional who can operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, supporting budgeting and forecasting cycles, improving reporting through automation, and acting as a finance partner to stakeholders. Role Context and Impact The Senior FP&A Analyst will play a key role in enhancing financial reporting and planning processes. This includes driving improvements through automation and AI-enabled analysis, supporting Hala's ongoing Oracle EPM implementation for planning, and providing critical financial insights across the business. The analyst will be a trusted partner, ensuring data integrity and contributing to continuous process improvements. Key Responsibilities Lead and support annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes, collaborating with business unit stakeholders. Prepare monthly management reporting, including variance analysis and commentary for senior leadership. Build, maintain, and improve financial models to support business planning and decision-making. Identify opportunities to automate and streamline reporting processes, including the use of AI tools, to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy. Support the rollout and ongoing use of Oracle EPM for budgeting, forecasting, and planning. Partner with SQL/BI tools to extract, analyze, and present financial and operational data. Liaise with stakeholders across finance, operations, and commercial teams in a collaborative manner. Support ad hoc financial analysis and business cases for key strategic initiatives. Ensure data integrity and consistency across financial reporting outputs. Contribute to the continuous improvement of FP&A processes, tools, and controls. Prepare commentary and presentation materials for quarterly board reporting. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in finance, with a focus on Financial Planning & Analysis. Background in fintech, payments, or startup environments is preferred. Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth setting. Experience with Oracle EPM or similar planning systems is beneficial. Proficiency in financial modeling and data analysis. Skills and Attributes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. Proficiency with SQL/BI tools for data extraction and analysis. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for stakeholder engagement. Attention to detail and commitment to data integrity. Work Location This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

96916d57c418f3fd.description: About SJ Group Surbana Jurong Group (SJ Group) is a global consulting firm specializing in urban, infrastructure, and managed services. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah, and combines project management operations, PMO governance, strategic planning, performance monitoring, and portfolio reporting. Support strategic planning and the management of capital project portfolios. Monitor project and portfolio performance against strategic objectives, schedules, and delivery targets. Prepare and analyze project performance reports, KPIs, and management dashboards. Oversee the implementation of project management systems and Enterprise Project Management (EPM) tools. 9633649c6c5da4a0.description: About the Role Awtad, a real estate development company in Saudi Arabia, is seeking an Accountant to join its financial team in Riyadh. This full-time role is essential for maintaining the integrity of financial operations and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. The Accountant will manage various accounting functions, supporting financial reporting and analysis for the company's projects. Key Responsibilities Manage and monitor accounts for suppliers and contractors related to projects. Review contracts, payment certificates, and invoices to ensure compliance with agreements, purchase orders, and payment terms. Reconcile supplier and contractor balances and perform necessary accounting adjustments. Monitor project costs, operating expenses, and petty cash transactions. Review due payments, amounts paid, and outstanding balances for each project. Record project-related journal entries and ensure the accuracy of financial documents. Follow up on invoices and payments, coordinating with suppliers, contractors, and relevant departments. Prepare periodic financial reports covering project costs, expenses, and financial obligations. Monitor Value Added Tax (VAT) and electronic invoicing requirements in accordance with Saudi Arabian regulations. Perform periodic accounting reconciliations and month-end and year-end closing activities. Maintain and organize financial records and supporting documents related to projects. Coordinate with Finance and Operations departments to ensure data accuracy and compliance with accounting procedures. Good knowledge of supplier and contractor accounts. Experience reviewing contracts, payment certificates, and invoices, and matching them against payments. Ability to reconcile account balances and perform accounting adjustments. Knowledge of project cost monitoring, operating expenses, and petty cash management. Knowledge of VAT and electronic invoicing requirements in Saudi Arabia. Required Skills Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting systems; experience with Odoo is preferred. Strong analytical and accounting skills, with excellent attention to detail. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

96402a218375078e.description: About the Role Leylaty Group is seeking a Sous Chef (French Italian Mediterranean Cuisine) to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assisting the Head Chef in managing kitchen operations, supervising staff, and ensuring the preparation of high-quality dishes. The position requires strong expertise in French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine, with a focus on authenticity, consistency, and presentation, contributing to maintaining kitchen efficiency, safety, and cleanliness. Key Responsibilities Assist the Head Chef in planning, developing, and executing menus, with a focus on French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine. Supervise kitchen staff and ensure proper food preparation, cooking techniques, and presentation standards. Monitor food quality, taste, and consistency to meet brand and culinary standards. Ensure adherence to all health, safety, and food hygiene regulations. Manage inventory, order supplies, and control food costs efficiently. Train and mentor kitchen staff on culinary techniques, recipes, and plating standards. Assist in scheduling staff shifts and managing daily kitchen operations. Maintain high levels of cleanliness and sanitation in all kitchen areas. Handle customer feedback, special dietary requests, and complaints when required. Support the Head Chef in fostering a positive, disciplined, and efficient kitchen environment. 96c8711f8b83e3c0.description: نبذة عن الدور يقوم استشاري المبيعات في مصرف الراجحي بتقديم وعرض المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء في المنطقة الغربية، وتحديداً في مدينة جدة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات مع ضمان أعلى مستويات الجودة والاحترافية في الخدمة المقدمة للعملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال طلبات بيع المنتجات المصرفية ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها في النظام. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، إدخال البيانات والتوقيع في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام إدارة المستندات (DMS). الترحيب بالعملاء عند دخول الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة لهم. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج اللازمة وتوجيههم لإنهاء معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح. توجيه العملاء حول كيفية تنفيذ العمليات المتاحة عبر أجهزة الصراف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية الأخرى. الاستجابة السريعة لمشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشكلات. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها في النظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة للعملاء. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات، وطلبات إغلاق الحسابات أو تعديلها وتسليمها لمدير العمليات. استقبال العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات نموذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيع، وإدخاله في النظام. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وطلبات تحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات البطاقات. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات المصرفية. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن الحالات المخالفة للأنظمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 1 إلى 5 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات جيدة في استخدام أنظمة الحاسب الآلي وتطبيقاته. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في جدة، المنطقة الغربية، ويتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء في بيئة الفرع.

96d8e3be53c5dd27.description: About Echelon Echelon is a Saudi-born technology company focused on bringing global AI technologies to Saudi Arabia and the world. The company deploys these technologies through its operations and productizes Saudi-developed capabilities. This business line specifically delivers leading AI technologies to major enterprises and institutions within the Kingdom. Role Overview: Business Operations The Business Operations role at Echelon is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role works directly with the business leader, acting as a chief of staff and business operations lead. The primary responsibility is to extend the leader's reach by preparing decisions, managing operational rhythms, representing the leader across various forums and business lines, and ensuring agreed actions are completed. Key Responsibilities Prepare decisions by framing issues, gathering facts and options, and briefing ahead of meetings. Manage operational rhythms, including business reviews, pipeline, and forecast cadences, and ensure follow-through on all actions. Track performance by owning dashboards that display pipeline, revenue, and account status, and highlight areas needing attention. Drive cross-team initiatives from conception to completion, collaborating with sales, delivery, partnerships, and finance. Represent the leader in meetings and with stakeholders, exercising sound judgment and discretion. Advise on business decisions by providing an independent view, pressure-testing options, surfacing trade-offs and risks, and recommending courses of action. Prepare for management forums, group committees, and board sessions by developing papers, aligning positions with stakeholders, and converting outcomes into actionable steps. Coordinate with other Echelon business lines and group functions to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and keep the leader informed of upcoming developments. Required Skills and Attributes Analytical: Comfortable with data, models, and dashboards, with the ability to translate numbers into clear recommendations. Organized: Capable of managing multiple workstreams simultaneously with structure, follow-through, and attention to detail. Trusted: Possesses the judgment and discretion required to handle sensitive information and represent a senior leader. Customer First: Measures work by customer outcomes and prioritizes accordingly. Ownership Mentality: Takes end-to-end ownership of outcomes and addresses issues proactively. Clear Communicator: Explains complex systems simply to various audiences and makes the value of work visible. Comfortable with Ambiguity: Makes progress with incomplete information and enjoys problem-solving in unstructured environments. Long-term Builder: Invests in the company's long-term success by integrating field insights into strategy and operations. Working Approach Curiosity: Understands how each team operates and what the business requires. Speed: Converts requests into trackers, briefs, or processes efficiently. Rigour: Verifies data accuracy and can explain its origin. Confidence & Humility: Challenges and accepts challenges, adapting views based on evidence. Autonomy: Makes decisions with incomplete information and organizes work independently based on desired outcomes. Resourcefulness: Finds solutions despite missing data, unclear ownership, or competing priorities. Situational Leadership: Leads when appropriate and follows when others have better insights. Force Multiplier: Enhances the efficiency of the leadership team through effective briefs, trackers, and follow-through. AI-native Depth: Utilizes AI tools for analysis, writing, and automation, with demonstrated experience in building useful applications. Experience Candidates should have several years of experience in consulting, strategy, operations, or a chief of staff role. The ideal candidate is numerate, discreet, and eager to learn.

96f695df41092f26.description: About the Role Saudi Aramco | أرامكو السعودية is seeking a Senior Corporate Strategy Advisor to join the Corporate Strategy Department. This full-time role is central to the company's strategy development and update process, applying best practices across upstream, downstream, new energies, and corporate strategy fields. Role Purpose and Impact The primary purpose of this role is to coordinate the development of the Company’s Corporate Strategy. The advisor will provide rigorous analytical and advisory support to facilitate strategic decision-making by Corporate Management. Additionally, the role involves leading the communication of the Corporate Strategy throughout the organization and through key Company publications. Key Responsibilities Act as a trusted Corporate Advisor on Corporate Strategy and related matters, offering strategic insight and process guidance to relevant departments and management. Lead the development and periodic update of the Company’s Corporate Strategy, collaborating with business strategists and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Develop, evaluate, and propose strategic options to Corporate and Executive Management, supported by robust quantitative and qualitative analysis. Prepare high-impact research, special studies, and strategic analyses for various corporate committees as required. Coordinate across Corporate Strategy groups and other departments to deliver integrated analyses supporting Corporate Strategy formulation and updates. Cultivate and sustain key matrix relationships, influencing stakeholders and advancing corporate strategic thinking for proactive strategy adjustment. Interface with, influence, and collaborate with SMEs, strategists, and professionals responsible for translating the Strategic Plan into business strategies. Lead and manage strategy consultants and external advisory teams, overseeing strategy-related projects and studies to support Corporate Strategy development and deliver strategic insights. Qualifications and Experience A distinguished track record across technical, operational, commercial, and strategic roles. Significant tenure, typically 20+ years, in Corporate Strategy or Corporate Planning positions. Direct and sustained engagement with top management (CEO, Executive Committee, and Business Leaders). Demonstrated ability to independently originate strategic inquiries and frame complex, ambiguous enterprise-level issues. Proven experience regularly advising and presenting to Corporate Management and Board-level audiences. Ability to represent the Company in external forums such as executive roundtables and conferences, building credibility with senior executives and peers.
